exposure: delivery ward crowding (number of births in a +-2-h interval around the index birth exceeding the 75th percentile)
cohort: The study included 1,027,620 births registered in Sweden between 2004 and 2019, with PPH cases matched to controls.
finding: Crowding in the delivery ward around the time of birth was not associated with an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, showing a modest reduction in risk instead.
mod_finding: Labor induction and emergency cesarean delivery were less common in births that occurred during crowded compared to noncrowded time intervals.
